blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano said on Monday that the mix-up in the coordinates of a flood control project billed to Taguig City, which pointed to Leyte, was due to the contractor’s error. Earlier, Sen. Panfilo Lacson asked the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to validate a flood control project billed to Taguig City, but whose geotagged coordinates pointed to a location in Leyte. “When I took the report, the contractor in Leyte is the contractor in Taguig, and he got messed up in dealing, but the project was done,” Cayetano said during the budget […]...
